activity_if_known: Struck by discharged object or substance

activity_if_known: Other fall to lower level 26 to 30 feet

activity_if_known: Struck by powered vehicle-nontransport, n.e.c.

activity_if_known: Fall through surface or existing opening 11 to 15 feet

activity_if_known: Other fall to lower level 6 to 10 feet

activity_if_known: Exposure to harmful substance through skin, eyes, or other exposed tissue, unspecified

activity_if_known: Injured by object handled by person  n.e.c.

activity_if_known: Entangled in other object or equipment

activity_if_known: Other fall to lower level 21 to 25 feet

activity_if_known: Injured by handheld object or equipment, n.e.c.

activity_if_known: Fall on same level due to slipping

activity_if_known: Struck, caught, or crushed in other collapsing structure or equipment

activity_if_known: Struck by discharged object or substance

activity_if_known: Pedestrian struck by vehicle in nonroadway area  unspecified

The employee was hospitalized.

activity_if_known: Struck by object falling from vehicle or machinery-other than vehicle part

activity_if_known: Struck by powered vehicle-nontransport, unspecified

activity_if_known: Fall from collapsing structure or equipment, unspecified

activity_if_known: Fall on same level, unspecified

activity_if_known: Struck by object or equipment, n.e.c.

activity_if_known: Struck or run over by rolling powered vehicle

activity_if_known: Hitting, kicking, beating by other person  n.e.c.

activity_if_known: Nonroadway noncollision  vehicle overturn

activity_if_known: Fall through surface or existing opening, unspecified

activity_if_known: Struck by object falling from vehicle or machinery-other than vehicle part

activity_if_known: Nonroadway collision with other vehicle, unspecified

activity_if_known: Explosion, n.e.c.

activity_if_known: Caught in running equipment or machinery, unspecified

activity_if_known: Struck by powered vehicle-nontransport, n.e.c.

He broke his right lower tibia and fibula.

activity_if_known: Fall on water vehicle

activity_if_known: Struck by swinging or slipping object, other than handheld, n.e.c.

activity_if_known: Caught in running equipment or machinery, n.e.c.

The wheels crushed the fingers of his right hand, causing amputations to the index, middle, and ring fingertips.

activity_if_known: Struck by object or equipment, n.e.c.

activity_if_known: Other fall to lower level 11 to 15 feet

activity_if_known: Indirect exposure to electricity, unspecified

activity_if_known: Exposure through intact skin, eyes, or other exposed tissue

activity_if_known: Contact with hot objects or substances

activity_if_known: Fall to lower level resulting from exposure or contact  unspecified

His left hand passed across the ceiling grid and was lacerated. He also suffered an electrical burn to the right hand and was hospitalized.

activity_if_known: Nonroadway incident involving motorized land vehicle  unspecified

activity_if_known: Struck by other falling powered vehicle

activity_if_known: Thrown, fell, or jumped from animal transportation

activity_if_known: Pedestrian struck by vehicle in nonroadway area, n.e.c.

activity_if_known: Struck by other falling object  n.e.c.

activity_if_known: Fall on same level while climbing stairs, steps, or curbs

activity_if_known: Fall through surface or existing opening, unspecified

activity_if_known: Fall onto or against object on same level, n.e.c.

activity_if_known: Fall through surface or existing opening 21 to 25 feet

He fell to the ground, sustaining a laceration to his left foot and a broken heel.

activity_if_known: Struck by falling object or equipment, unspecified

activity_if_known: Indirect exposure to electricity, greater than 220 volts

activity_if_known: Pedestrian struck by vehicle in nonroadway area, unspecified

activity_if_known: Indirect exposure to electricity, greater than 220 volts

activity_if_known: Caught in or compressed by equipment or objects, unspecified

The finger was partially amputated at the midsection of the distal phalanx.

activity_if_known: Struck by other falling object  n.e.c.

activity_if_known: Contact incidents  unspecified

activity_if_known: Slip, trip, stumble while stepping between levels

activity_if_known: Pedestrian vehicular incident, unspecified

activity_if_known: Pedestrian struck by vehicle in nonroadway area, unspecified

activity_if_known: Fall through surface or existing opening 6 to 10 feet

activity_if_known: Other jump to lower level, unspecified

activity_if_known: Other fall to lower level  6 to 30 feet

activity_if_known: Other fall to lower level 11 to 15 feet
narrative: On 3/13/17, a ladder slipped while an employee accessed an elevator pit and the employee fell 14 feet to the elevator platform. The employee then rolled and fell an additional 6 feet to the elevator pit, suffering a hairline fracture to the head.

activity_if_known: Nonclassifiable

activity_if_known: Pedestrian struck by forward-moving vehicle in nonroadway area

activity_if_known: Inhalation of harmful substance-single episode

activity_if_known: Contact incidents  unspecified

activity_if_known: Other fall to lower level  6 to 30 feet
narrative: An employee lost balance and fell 20 feet from the roof edge to the ground below and landed on his feet before bouncing onto a pile of plywood and 2 x 6 lumber. Fall protection was not connected to an anchor point at the time.

activity_if_known: Inhalation of harmful substance-single episode

activity_if_known: Other fall to lower level, unspecified
narrative: An employee was measuring the produced water depth using a gauge line. After measuring, the employee began climbing down the storage tank ladder and fell. As he fell, his boots became caught between the ladder rungs, causing a right femur and left hip fracture.

activity_if_known: Explosion of nonpressurized vapors, gases, or liquids

activity_if_known: Fall through surface or existing opening 21 to 25 feet
narrative: An employee was walking upstairs when a stair gave way. The employee fell 24 feet to the ground and suffered a broken leg.

activity_if_known: Fall to lower level resulting from exposure or contact  unspecified

activity_if_known: Exposure through unintentional needlestick or sharp injury

activity_if_known: Pedestrian struck by forward-moving vehicle in nonroadway area

activity_if_known: Struck by rolling object or equipment being pushed by injured worker

activity_if_known: Exposure to electricity  unspecified
narrative: At 1:25 p.m. on March 13, 2025, a Michels Pacific Energy (MPE) crew was terminating new wires connecting a new three-phase sector and an existing pad-mounted switch elbow connected switch gear 20 feet away. The circuit being worked on was de-energized and isolated. All other circuits in the switch gear were insulated with insulating caps. After termination of the elbow, a strand of the new concentric neutral wire, used for bleeding capacitance, moved and made contact with the insulated bushing cover in the switch gear. The concentric neutral became energized from induced current at an unknown voltage. An employee working in the new sector was shocked on the right hand.

activity_if_known: Other fall to lower level  6 to 30 feet
narrative: A bricklayer was working from a scaffold striking the mortar joints when they fell six feet to the ground and sustained fractures to their ribs, neck, and wrist.

activity_if_known: Pedestrian struck by vehicle in nonroadway area, unspecified
narrative: An employee was walking through the dock when they were struck by a forklift, resulting in a left ankle fracture.

activity_if_known: Nonroadway noncollision  fall or jump from moving vehicle

activity_if_known: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object
narrative: An employee was at the airport walking away from the baggage claim area with her luggage and computer case in front of her. activity_if_known: Fall or jump curtailed by personal fall arrest system

activity_if_known: Struck bump, hole, rough terrain on driving surface, nonroadway

activity_if_known: Direct exposure to electricity, greater than 220 volts

activity_if_known: Fall through surface or existing opening, unspecified

activity_if_known: Struck against moving part of machinery or equipment

activity_if_known: Collision between a moving and standing vehicle, nonroadway
narrative: An employee was waiting on a forklift for another forklift driver to move out of the picking area so he could pull items for an order. When the forklift driver turned, the pallet it was carrying struck and broke the employee's ankle, requiring hospitalization.

activity_if_known: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object
narrative: A temporary employee stepped inside a packaging tote to collect parts and move them into a smaller container. Upon exiting the packaging tote, his foot was caught on the side of the tote, causing him to trip and fall to the floor. He broke his hip and was hospitalized.

activity_if_known: Struck by running powered equipment  n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was processing meat on a meat saw. His hand slipped and came into contact with a circular blade, which lacerated his right index finger, resulting in a partial amputation. The employee was hospitalized. The machine was not guarded at the time.

activity_if_known: Flash fire
narrative: An employee was attempting to light an outdoor wood fire pizza oven. The employee added lighter fluid to the wood and used a torch to light the fire when it back-drafted onto his right hand and arm. The employee suffered first-degree burns to his forearm and second-degree burns to his hand and the crease of his arm.

activity_if_known: Struck or run over by rolling powered vehicle
narrative: An employee was using an electric hand jack on the mixing floor when the jack backed over his right foot, bending his toes back. His toes broke, requiring surgery.

activity_if_known: Struck by object or equipment dropped by other person
narrative: Two employees in a scissor lift were wrecking forms, taking forms down, and removing the forms. They lost their grip on the form, which fell and hit an employee walking below on the shoulder, knocking him to the ground. He hit his head on the concrete, causing a wound to the head, a broken collarbone, and a broken rib.

activity_if_known: Explosion of nonpressurized vapors, gases, or liquids
narrative: At 4:26 p.m. on September 13, 2022, a moisture was introduced to molten iron causing a steam explosion. A nearby employee felt and heard the explosion, causing him to strike the top of his hard hat on an air duct. The employee suffered a concussion and had difficulty breathing and was hospitalized.

activity_if_known: Fall onto or against object on same level, n.e.c.
narrative: An employee slipped on the floor while walking near the cook line and tried to stop the fall by placing their right forearm on a flat-top grill. The employee sustained second degree burns and was hospitalized.

activity_if_known: Fall through surface or existing opening 16 to 20 feet
narrative: While carrying HVAC equipment on a roof, an employee walked over a foam board covering and fell approximately 18 feet through the rough opening of the skylight to a lower level floor. The employee broke both ankles and suffered a fractured vertebra.

activity_if_known: Part of occupant s body caught between vehicle and other object in nonroadway transport incident
narrative: An employee was operating a stand-up powered industrial truck (PIT) when he collided with a storage rack. His left arm was pinched and broken between the rack and the PIT.

activity_if_known: Struck by rolling object or equipment being pushed by injured worker
narrative: An employee was pushing a loaded pallet to the end of a conveyor at a press. The employee noticed a plastic pad lying in front of the pallet and was removing it when the pallet, still rolling, pinched the employee's right ring finger against the metal conveyor end stop amputating it.

activity_if_known: Struck by rolling powered vehicle or machinery
narrative: An employee walked behind a moving forklift. The forklift struck him and knocked him to the ground, resulting in a broken ankle.

activity_if_known: Struck by falling object or equipment, n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was making welding repairs to one of the pad eyes on a 30 inch Blow Out Preventer (BOP). The task required the employee to place the BOP on a table positioner. While welding the 14,000 lbs. piece, it fell from the table crushing the employee's left foot.

activity_if_known: Fall to lower level, unspecified
narrative: An employee was trimming a tree while in a backyard bucket lift. The bucket, with the employee inside, descended to the ground, causing the employee to sustain fractures to the lumbar vertebrae.

activity_if_known: Ignition of vapors, gases, or liquids
narrative: An employee was cutting a piece of duct work to size using a grinder with a cut-off wheel. The pipe was staged on the back of a truck parked approximately 5 feet from two manhole covers. As the employee was cutting, vapors from an underground tank beneath the manhole covers ignited, causing first degree flash burns to the employee's torso, chest, hands, arms, head, face, neck, and back and second degree burns to the chest and hands.

activity_if_known: Nonroadway collision with other vehicle, unspecified
narrative: An employee was driving a forklift when it struck another forklift in the loading dock area. The employee sustained a broken bone in his left hand.

activity_if_known: Fall through surface or existing opening 11 to 15 feet
narrative: An employee climbed on a roof, fell through a rusted area, and landed on the concrete floor approximately 11 feet below, breaking 10 ribs and the tailbone.

activity_if_known: Explosion of nonpressurized vapors, gases, or liquids
narrative: During fiberglass work, an employee mixed a methyl ethyl ketone peroxide (MEKP) catalyst with a cobalt chemical that they thought was a dye. A chemical reaction occurred, resulting in an explosion. The employee sustained second-degree burns on his back and a blister on his right arm.

activity_if_known: Fall to lower level from collapsing structure or equipment  6 to 30 feet
narrative: On August 7, 2024, a maintenance technician was descending a fixed cage ladder when the ladder broke and they fell approximately 12 feet to the concrete ground. The employee sustained head injuries and fractured ribs.

activity_if_known: Struck by falling object or equipment, n.e.c.
narrative: Two employees were welding the cracked edges of a crucible. The crucible fell off the platform on which it was placed. Employee 1 suffered a hip fracture when part of the crucible fell onto his hip while he was on the floor welding. Employee 2 was struck on the back of the head by a piece of the hoisting material resulting in a skull fracture. Both employees were hospitalized.

activity_if_known: Fall from collapsing structure or equipment 6 to 10 feet
narrative: An employee was carrying a floor truss across other set trusses when the truss he stepped on broke and he fell 9 feet to the floor, fracturing his ribs and shoulder.

activity_if_known: Struck by swinging part of powered vehicle
narrative: An employee was setting up wheel chocks on the tire of an aircraft. The vehicle that was going to be used to load catered food onto the aircraft deployed its stabilizing outriggers. The outriggers crushed the first digit of the little toe on the employee's left foot.

activity_if_known: Hitting, kicking, beating, shoving
narrative: While on patrol, an employee noticed two males fighting and observed that one of the males needed medical attention. The employee approached the male, who became agitated and entangled with the employee. The male fell on the employee's ankle and broke it.

activity_if_known: Struck by falling part of powered vehicle still attached
narrative: While an employee was moving lumber in row one using a diesel-powered forklift, the top two packs of lumber in row two fell onto the forklift, causing the forklift cage to fail. The cage then struck the employee, fracturing his scapula and dislocating his collarbone. He was hospitalized.

activity_if_known: Fall on same level while climbing stairs, steps, or curbs
narrative: An employee was entering his workplace building. While walking up the steps, he tripped on the stairs and fell onto his side on the landing. The employee was hospitalized with a leg fracture.

activity_if_known: Struck by object dropped by person
narrative: Two employees were lifting a hydraulic tank when the tank slipped and crushed the injured employee's right index finger against a trailer, resulting in an amputation of the finger and hospitalization.

activity_if_known: Struck by other propelled object or substance  n.e.c.
narrative: On June 6, 2025, at approximately 9:33 PM, a maintenance employee was placing the chain back on a drive wheel of a shackle line when the chain hoist/come along he was using detached from its anchorage point. His right little finger was crushed between the chain hoist/come along and the guard for the drive wheel. The employee sustained an open fracture and partial amputation to the finger.

activity_if_known: Struck by or caught in swinging door or gate
narrative: An employee's right thumb was crushed in a doorjamb. The employee was hospitalized.

activity_if_known: Caught in running equipment or machinery, n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was on a 3-foot ladder guiding cable onto a spool during installation on an overhead door. As the control box was jogged, the employee's hand was caught between the cable and spool, resulting in a wrist and hand fracture.

activity_if_known: Contact with objects and equipment, unspecified
narrative: As an employee was stepping down from a step ladder, their right middle finger got caught between the employee's tool holder and the ladder. The employee's fingernail was removed and the finger was fractured. The employee was hospitalized.

activity_if_known: Struck against stationary object or equipment, n.e.c.
narrative: An employee climbed up a ladder to work on top of a rendering machine. She lost grip on a tool and her right hand hit the machine, fracturing a hand bone.
